recall_findings.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6. You are writing sections of an SEO audit report.

Full outline:
{audit_outline}

Sections to draft in order:
1. Executive Summary
2. On-Page SEO Analysis
3. Meta Tags & Open Graph Review
4. Page Speed & Performance Indicators
5. Content Structure & Readability
6. Internal Linking + Competitor Comparison + Scoring Matrix + Recommendations

Reply with ONLY the section name for iteration {iteration}.

store_draft.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6 complete. Section written: {section_pick}

If iteration is less than 6, reply YES to continue. If iteration is 6, reply NO — all sections are drafted.
